rationale.question: Can a complete monthly contrarian policy over existing style ETFs supply behavior complementary to momentum, price-trend, option, covariance, credit and calendar experts?
rationale.premise: Temporary relative style-flow pressure and rebalancing may be followed by recovery. This is a falsifiable premise, not an observed recovery or demonstrated ETF alpha.
rationale.research_choices: One roughly one-month signal, a monthly commitment and an equal-capital bottom-two basket are fixed before outcomes. Twelve-decimal ranking and lexical ties make numerical tie handling explicit. No window, count, cutoff, weight, band or execution search.
rationale.distinct_from_prior_reversion: This policy ranks admitted asset close ratios. It is not OLMAR/PAMR, a prediction of expert NET wealth, a repair of a stopped archived policy, a new RF assessment view or a source-Interface waiver.
rationale.risk_and_cost: Relatively weak equity styles can keep losing together. This is long-only equity exposure, not a market hedge or an independent risk source. Concentration, one-month commitment, holding drift, delayed fills, actual turnover, tickets and costs can defeat the premise.
rationale.source_scope: Use only the admitted fourteen-asset market, its six existing style families and the original calendar. No new quote, holdings refresh, vintage, traded asset or source scope is admitted. Missing history produces no opinion; invalid input fails rather than becoming a safe BIL state.
rationale.introduction: Native historical opinions would assume counterfactual policy availability. Actual definition, registration and technical admission happen now and are never backdated. All 258 prior completions are exposed.
rationale.future_finance: Preparation is not a financial trial, technical expert admission or pool membership. A separately frozen financial implementation, actual registration and publication must precede real targets and all four original funded paths, actual family participation and independent accounting.
